description: seed.rs says fixtures are 'derived from the jmap-test-suite seed-data spec' but does not say where that spec lives or link to it. seed_fixture_tests.rs has the link (~/GIT/jmap-test-suite/src/setup/seed-data.ts) but seed.rs itself does not. A new contributor reading seed.rs alone cannot find the authoritative spec to verify or extend fixtures. Add the path to the module-level doc comment in seed.rs.
title: seed.rs: no link to jmap-test-suite fixture spec
